tax.text: Khanna authored a progressive plan to raise revenue by taxing corporations and billionaires to fund programs like childcare, universal healthcare, affordable housing, and free college.
tax.quote: essential programs for ordinary Americans: childcare, universal healthcare, affordable housing, free college, student debt cancellation, advanced manufacturing, and good-paying jobs.

wages.text: Khanna has repeatedly pushed to raise the federal minimum wage, writing that the country should pay everyone at least $15 an hour.
wages.quote: Nationally, we should pay everyone at least $15 an hour.

trade.text: Khanna supports strategic, targeted tariffs to protect industry while opposing Trump's blanket tariffs, a mixed position between the two sides.
trade.quote: What we need is smart trade, strategic trade, not tantrum trade!

debt.text: On his official House issues page Khanna pledges to protect Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid and to oppose any cuts to them.
debt.quote: I will oppose any efforts to slash funding for any of these vital social safety net programs.

housing.text: On his official House page Khanna backs legislation to build millions of new housing units and aligns with loosening restrictive zoning.
housing.quote: Controls the cost of renting or buying a home by leveraging federal funding to build up to 3.2 million new housing units for lower-income and middle-class families.

schools.text: Khanna's official page focuses on strengthening and funding the public school system and raising teacher pay, with no support for vouchers.
schools.quote: It is vital that we continue to improve our public school system from the bottom up.

safety.text: Khanna's official page supports both increasing funding for community policing and funding grant programs to train mental health responders.
safety.quote: I have been proud to support bipartisan legislation to invest in community policing and support increasing funding and hiring capacity.

immigration.text: Khanna's official page advocates legal status for DREAMers, pathways to citizenship, family reunification and guest worker visas, and asylum for refugees.
immigration.quote: I will advocate for legal status for DREAMers, pathways to citizenship for productive adults, family reunification visas, guest worker visa programs, and asylum for refugees.

guns.text: On his official House website Khanna calls for background checks on all gun sales and a federal assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: we should require background checks for all gun sales

abortion.text: After Roe v. Wade was overturned, Khanna issued a statement condemning the decision and vowing to fight to preserve abortion rights.
abortion.quote: Now, we must mobilize and do everything possible to save the right to an abortion.

gender.text: Supports protections against discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity and advocates for LGBTQ+ equality.
gender.quote: I believe that no person should be discriminated based on sexual orientation or gender identity.

health.text: On his official House issues page Khanna states he supports creating a single-payer Medicare for All system.
health.quote: I support the creation of a single-payer health care system, or Medicare for All.

energy.text: On his official House issues page Khanna backs repealing fossil fuel subsidies and closing fracking loopholes to address the climate crisis.
energy.quote: I support legislation to repeal fossil fuel subsidies and close loopholes for fracking that exempt Big Oil companies from clean water and air regulations.

voting.text: Khanna voted for the Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act, which would set federal standards allowing same-day registration, early voting, and no-excuse mail voting.
voting.quote: The bill would establish federal standards for voting access such as allowing for same-day voter registration, establishing Election Day as a public holiday, requiring states to allow a minimum number of days for early voting, and allowing people to vote absentee by mail for any reason.

tax.text: Tandon's economic agenda centers on tax cuts for working families and small businesses and opposing new taxes such as a state wealth tax.
tax.quote: Oppose a California billionaire wealth tax that risks driving investment, founders, and job creators out of the state.

debt.text: Tandon supports cutting government spending to reduce the national debt while also reforming and adequately funding Social Security.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt.

housing.text: Tandon supports increasing housing supply through federal incentives, faster local permitting, and workforce housing near jobs and transit.
housing.quote: Expand federal incentives for new housing supply, reward faster local permitting, support first-time homebuyer savings tools, and grow workforce housing near jobs and transit.

schools.text: Tandon strongly supports school choice, including vouchers, charter schools, private schools, tax credits, and homeschooling.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.

safety.text: He opposes the defund-the-police movement, contrasting himself with his opponent on police funding.
safety.quote: My opponent supports the Defund the Police movement.

immigration.text: Tandon calls for a secure border, consistent enforcement, ending catch-and-release, E-Verify, and opposing sanctuary cities.
immigration.quote: America must have a secure border and consistent enforcement of immigration law.

guns.text: Tandon supports background checks and a range of additional firearm restrictions, including waiting periods, safe-storage laws, licensing, and red-flag laws.
guns.quote: Background checks, Mental Health Assessments, Waiting Periods, Ban on High-Capacity Magazines, Red Flag Laws, Safe Storage Laws, Training and Licensing, Age Restrictions, Limit on Number of Purchases, Tracking and Reporting

abortion.text: Tandon says abortion should generally be allowed only when the mother's life is in danger and opposes public funding for abortion providers.
abortion.quote: When mother life is in danger

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Tandon opposes allowing biological males to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces

cannabis.quote: I support the legalization of recreational marijuana. Disagree

health.text: On a candidate survey he strongly disagreed with eliminating private health insurance.
health.quote: I support the elimination of private healthcare insurance.

energy.text: Tandon frames energy policy around delivering reliable, affordable energy to lower household costs rather than accelerating emissions cuts.
energy.quote: Deliver reliable, affordable energy and transportation to reduce monthly household costs.

voting.text: Tandon's election-integrity plank emphasizes that only eligible U.S. citizens should decide elections.
voting.quote: U.S. elections must be decided only by eligible American citizens under federal and state law.
